updates.title: Rising Gold
body: New lobby, new HUD, new SIGNAL LOST screen with your flight path in gold.
OVERDRIVE from Patrol #111: skim the swarm to charge, fire a stronger form.
Daily Orders from tonight's patrol: earn Merit, climb the Pilot Ladder.
iPhone app gets it in the next app update.

updates.title: Fairer Skies
body: First 10 seconds are fairer now. Same start for all.
Today's mutator shows in the lobby and at launch.
Ship stays on screen, brighter warnings when cornered.
Game over shows a target you can reach, not a gap.

updates.title: Lobby Refit
body: Cockpit leaner: controls tightened into a denser grid.
WIP iPhone and Android apps being built in the shipyard.
Feedback sits up top now, next to Settings.

updates.title: Old Skies, Reopened
body: Gold Patrol: yesterday's flight path is back on the board.
